title: Generators of II₁ factors
author: Claude Opus 5.5 (Anthropic)
description: Every II₁ factor with separable predual is generated by one operator, equivalently by two self-adjoint operators (OpenAI, 2026). Haar unitaries and freeness of a unitary from a C*-algebra in tracial von Neumann algebras; tracial ultraproducts; Popa's free independence theorem for irreducible inclusions, proved by patching partial isometries with local quantization in corners; Haagerup's inequality for words of length one and a perturbation of a unitary whose correlation with a fixed vector stays uniform along long words; relative generation W*(P,u) = M for a dense G_δ set of unitaries u; irreducible hyperfinite subfactors, two self-adjoint generators of the hyperfinite factor and a 2×2 matrix encoding. The last lesson deduces the full generator problem: every von Neumann algebra on a separable Hilbert space, and every von Neumann algebra with separable predual, is generated by one operator. Properly infinite algebras are singly generated through a sequence of matrix units (Wogen); finite factors are matrix algebras or II₁ factors; and a direct integral of singly generated algebras is singly generated, by a Borel choice of fibre generators and a merging of the diagonal algebra (Willig). A sixth lesson proves that the generator invariant of Dykema, Sinclair, Smith and White vanishes, G(M) = G_sa(M) = 0, for every II₁ factor with separable predual.
prerequisites: Course foundations-of-von-neumann-algebras (double commutant and Kaplansky density theorems, polar decomposition, comparison of projections, spectral projections, preduals, Baire and Banach–Alaoglu)
Course type-iii-factors, lesson on ultraproducts (Theorems 3.2, 3.3, Lemma 1.4: tracial ultraproducts)
OA-SUBFACTORS lesson finite-phase-local-quantization (Lemma 55.1, Theorem 55.7: local quantization)
OA-APPROX lessons abelian-pinching-and-relative-commutants (Lemma 3.1), masas-in-expected-semifinite-subfactors (Theorem 2.1) and infinite-tensor-products (Corollary 5.3)

foundations-of-von-neumann-algebras lessons projections-and-types-of-von-neumann-algebras (Theorem 7.2, Proposition 8.4, Proposition 15.3(3)), abelian-operator-algebras (Theorem 8.2), kaplansky-s-density-theorem-and-its-consequences (Theorem 7.1), compact-and-trace-class-operators-the-predual-of-b-h-and-the-operator-topologies (Theorems 6.2(d), 9.4(a)); measurable-fields-and-direct-integrals lesson the-central-decomposition-and-the-types-of-the-fibres (Facts 1.1, 1.2, 1.7(a), Theorem 4.1, Lemma 5.1, Theorem 5.3); OA-FOUND-REMAINDER reader base-changes-and-disintegration (Lemma 4.2)
